grader.required_boundary: Candidate package runs in a separate network-disabled container. The task API shim contains no assertions, test cases, or expected values. Hidden call cases and expected outputs remain in the trusted parent process.

limitations: Development-only candidate; not eligible as a held-out task.
Task source is public upstream history and model-training exposure is unknown.
Accelerate tasks share one repository; two target the same source module but different methods.
The split_between_processes case simulates PartialState rank metadata; it does not launch distributed workers.
The MULTI_CPU barrier case mocks torch.distributed.barrier and does not prove multi-process rendezvous behavior.
This record is a source/test qualification screen only; no agent rollout or policy update is included.
